tools.name: ti_search_companies
tools.description: Search Tehran Index's public registry of Iranian technology companies by name or slug. Returns identity fields and how many sourced facts each record carries.

tools.name: ti_get_company
tools.description: One company record by slug, with its public facts. Every fact carries its value as the source stated it, the period, the evidence state and the source URL.

tools.name: ti_list_signals
tools.description: Recent published, desk-verified market signals on Iran's digital economy, newest first.

tools.name: ti_coverage
tools.description: Honest coverage counts for the registry: companies tracked, how many carry sourced facts, and what the desk does not yet cover.
